title: An aperiodic set of Wang tiles for every quadratic irrational
summary: We propose a sufficient condition for the non-periodicity of a set of Wang tiles. It applies to sets of Wang tiles whose tiles have vertical or horizontal stripes. The proof is based on a geometric argument involving a quadrilateral circumscribed to a parabola from which we conclude the irrationality of the densities of the vertical and horizontal stripes. We apply the sufficient condition to propose new proofs of non-periodicity of known sets of Wang tiles, including an encoding of Penrose tilings into 24 Wang tiles and the family of metallic mean Wang tiles.
